effects.does: Clicking Copy copies the available project or QCS content, but the exact copied content cannot be determined from the label alone.
effects.affects: It may create clipboard content or a duplicate record, but the affected data cannot be determined.
effects.check: Click Copy and verify whether a copy confirmation or clipboard change appears.

effects.does: Clicking the copy icon performs an unspecified copy action.
effects.affects: The affected event data or clipboard content cannot be determined from the icon alone.
effects.check: Click the icon and verify what content or record, if any, is copied.

effects.does: Clicking Ask Clara opens the Clara assistance experience for the project.
effects.affects: It starts an assistance interaction without changing the event record unless a Clara action is subsequently confirmed.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara interface opens.

effects.does: Clicking Create New Version starts creation of a new project version when versioning is allowed.

effects.check: Click Create New Version and verify that the creation screen opens with the new version editable.

effects.does: Clicking Messages opens the project communication hub.
effects.affects: It changes the communication view but does not alter sourcing, bid, or award data.

effects.does: Clicking Hide fields toggles the visibility of fields in the QCS view.
effects.affects: It changes only the displayed fields and does not change event data.

effects.does: Clicking Download Report starts downloading a report for the displayed QCS.
effects.affects: It creates a report file without changing the event, proposals, or award state.
effects.check: Click Download Report and verify that a report download starts.

effects.does: Clicking Start Awarding opens the awarding flow for the lot when awarding is permitted.
effects.affects: It advances the event from bid comparison toward award selection and may open bid-justification instead of navigation when a pending justification exists.

effects.does: Clicking Project Details switches from Master QCS to the project details view.
effects.affects: It changes the selected project-details tab without changing event data.

effects.does: Clicking RFQ switches to the RFQ stage view.
effects.affects: It changes the displayed event stage without changing the project record.

effects.does: Clicking Master QCS keeps the Master QCS view selected.
effects.affects: It changes no event data and retains the vendor comparison view.

effects.does: Clicking Project opens the parent project view.
effects.affects: It changes navigation context without changing event data.
effects.check: Click Project and verify that the project details page opens.
